Name: Bewitching Bath and Beyond (AT)
Author: ashleyketchumtr
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][img]https://imgur.com/MLlCPcf.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/DQY1Lua.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

Add a touch of magic to your farmhouse! This mod features 70 new items inclulding enchanted bathtubs, sinks, toilets, mirrors, bookshelves, rugs, wall art, and more. Perfect for witches, mystics, and lovers of the occult!

[img]https://imgur.com/3HSguL4.png[/img]

Ensure you have[b] Alternative Textures[/b] installed.
Download and extract into your Mods folder.
Purchase the [b]paint bucket[/b] from Robin to apply the new designs.

[img]https://imgur.com/wj5MRXn.png[/img]﻿
